summary: Implemented SHACL path parsing. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) using the prepared venv. Nothing committed. mypy and black are not installed in that venv, so type-ignore placement and 88-column limits were checked by reading only. Added a Node guard before graph lookups because None would act as a wildcard in Graph.triples.
